name: The Yule Isle
about: Winter's legends together on one island: the ogress who comes down from the mountain with her sack, the horned one with the birch switch, and the goblins who climb out from under the world for the twelve nights. Through December the Yule Cat walks the whole continent.

lair.place: The fell with the cave mouth

krampus.name: Krampus
krampus.tale: The horned, shaggy one who walks behind Saint Nicholas on the night of 5 December, rattling his chains, with birch switches for the bad children and a basket on his back for the worst.

gryla.name: Grýla
gryla.tale: The ogress of the Icelandic mountains, fifteen tails and a hundred bags on each, who comes down at Yule for the children who misbehaved and takes them home to her pot.

kallikantzaros.name: Kallikantzaros
kallikantzaros.tale: A goblin that saws all year at the tree holding up the world, then climbs out for the twelve nights of Christmas to ride people and foul the food, until the Epiphany waters drive it back under.
